تحترفون (form VIII)
# تَحْتَرِفُونَ (taḥtarifūna) /taħ.ta.ri.fuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِحْتَرَفَ (iḥtarafa)
# تُحْتَرَفُونَ (tuḥtarafūna) /tuħ.ta.ra.fuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِحْتَرَفَ (iḥtarafa)
